# Ruby Gillis

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is characterized by her real showy looks, which include large, bright-blue eyes and a brilliant complexion. She has a plump, showy figure and wears her yellow hair in a long braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is cheerful and good-tempered, frankly enjoying life's pleasantries, though she is also rather sentimental and inclined toward hysteria. She is heavily focused on beaus, aiming to have one by the age of fifteen, and plans to marry after teaching for just two years. Additionally, she harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## History

Ruby Gillis once hid in a hall pantry when Malcolm Andres proposed to her sister [Susan](../character/susan.md), and she notably charmed away all of her warts using a magic pebble. She joined a story club formed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), where they wrote compositions together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby Gillis is a friend and school playmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Along with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, Ruby joined Anne's newly formed story club when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turned thirteen, where they collaborate on writing compositions. Following Anne's ankle injury, Ruby was among the school friends who visited her during her weeks of recovery.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), +9 more_
